# Applied AI Engineer
Corvid Health · Full-time

What you'll do

- Build retrieval pipelines over clinical documents.
- Partner with clinicians and product managers on what to build.
- Monitor latency and cost in production.

Requirements

- 2+ years of software engineering experience in Python.
- Hands-on work with LLM APIs: prompting, structured output and tool use.
- Experience with RAG systems.
- Experience building REST APIs with FastAPI or Flask.

Nice to have

- Experience with LangChain or LangGraph.
- Cloud experience on AWS.
- Experience fine-tuning small models.

What we offer

- Salary range $100,000–$130,000 plus equity.
- Health, dental and vision coverage.

Corvid Health is an equal opportunity employer. Fictional posting for RightStaff tests.
